description: Production-reality probe: replicates the /technical/end path, which sends NO transcript (the n8n workflow never fetches one, so the LLM sees 'TRANSCRIPT: Not available'). Verifies the grader degrades gracefully: no fabricated candidate quotes, facts still echoed. Communication/Independence grades are blind here — that is the finding this fixture documents.

hintLog.topic: think about what data structure gives fast lookups

question.constraints: 2 <= nums.length <= 10^5; -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; exactly one valid answer exists.

optimal.approach: Single pass with a hash map of seen values -> index; check complement before inserting

common_mistakes: Sorting first and losing original indices

follow_ups.variant: What if the array is sorted?
follow_ups.angle: Two pointers, O(n) time O(1) space
